description: This file defines a React functional component named UsersList, which displays a list of users with filtering, searching, and pagination features. It imports UI components and an API client, manages state for user data, filters, and UI interactions, and renders a data table with user information.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches all users from the API and updates the component state with the retrieved data.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Handles delete action initiation for a user row (stub, no actual delete logic).

methods.name: resetFilters
methods.description: Resets all filters and search queries to show the full user list.

methods.name: handleRowClick
methods.description: Handles row click events, delegating to parent callbacks if provided.
